PS.notes: UPU sheet (05/2025): 8-char code 'P'+governorate+sector+zone (3 digits) + 4-digit delivery point, the latter 'if possible', written right of the locality ('JERUSALEM P126xxxx'). Introduced in the West Bank in Feb 2021. Gaza has a separate postal administration and it is unclear the codes are used there; areas under Israeli control use Israel Post 7-digit codes. Low confidence on whether Z should be required. Recommend required AC with Z optional if the product serves Gaza or East Jerusalem.

With one postcode field we can hold only one of the two. Leaving PAK out still delivers (5-digit post-office code + street is enough) but is not compliant.
